architectures.feedforward: Linear(9,64), ReLU, Linear(64,52), ReLU, Linear(52,5); biases

configuration.shuffle: seeded whole-group permutation each epoch; all four complete resident sequences stay together
configuration.checkpoint_selection: lowest validation nonforced group-balanced NLL; exact ties choose earliest epoch

emission.name: zero/maximum-inflated beta-binomial
emission.legal_support: 0,...,floor(observed offer), without epsilon or upward rounding
emission.forced: n=0 has P(0)=1, zero primary loss, and retained observation history
emission.overlap: beta-binomial includes both endpoints; overlapping mixture masses are added

configuration.primary_score: mean nonforced choice NLL within each group, mean groups within mechanism, equal mean over four mechanisms
configuration.bin_closure: lower-inclusive, upper-exclusive; final upper edge included
configuration.seed_aggregation: equal mean of group scores over all three seeds; no lucky seed selection
configuration.uncertainty: paired mechanism-stratified group bootstrap; same resampled groups for every model
configuration.rollout_sampling: independent resident draws conditional on simultaneous pre-decision observations and separate histories
configuration.rollout_padding: zero pool/offers/returns/surplus after exact-zero termination; cumulative surplus held constant
configuration.rollout_parameters: best-validation weights frozen during play; recurrent states reset per independent game
configuration.representative_display: recurrent training seed 17, Equal; nearest median surplus with stable rollout-index tie break
configuration.held_out_status: held out from Task 03 fitting/selection, previously described by Task 01; no cross-group participant linkage available
configuration.transfer_boundary: Experiments 2-3 remain outside preparation, fitting, selection, and outcome inspection; Experiment 4 deferred

configuration.status: diagnostic follow-up informed by already published Experiment 1 results
configuration.checkpoint_selection: lowest validation group-balanced nonforced NLL over epochs 1..480, earliest exact tie; original best eligible
configuration.restart: restore original epoch-120 last.pt model, Adam, torch RNG and PCG64 shuffle state
configuration.primary_population: recorded current offers contain at least one offer >=1 at k=5
configuration.primary_effect: continued minus original recurrent energy score
endpoint: total retained resources within forecast window / (200*h)
configuration.energy_score: mean distance to observed endpoint minus off-diagonal pairwise distance sum/(2*M*(M-1)); no clipping
configuration.crps: univariate energy score with same off-diagonal finite-sample estimator
configuration.seed_aggregation: score each fitted seed separately then mean within human group
configuration.mechanism_aggregation: mean groups within mechanism then equally weight mechanisms; missing strata explicitly unavailable
configuration.main_first_allocation: recorded current allocation; preserve unallocated resource
configuration.numerical_sensitivity: canonical first allocation only; original and continued neural fits; k=5 h=10 eligible groups; paired first-bank seeds
configuration.future_allocation: canonical existing Equal/Mixed/Proportional using generated history and pool
configuration.termination: exact zero, absorbing zero padding; cumulative forecast-window surplus held constant
configuration.prefix: process observations 0..k-1 only; origin k observation processed once; no current/future targets enter input
configuration.display_default: first sorted Mixed test group, recurrent seed 17 continued, origin 5, branch index 0; all groups and failed forecasts accessible
configuration.reserved: Experiments 2-3 excluded; Experiment 4 deferred; no live M1 or Interpolating comparison
